gotchas: Signup is the Flying Blue enrolment on the shared Air France-KLM identity host, https://identity.airfranceklm.com/enrol/flyingblue (off this host). From www.klm.co.uk: /information/flying-blue -> 'Join Flying Blue' card. The homepage 'Sign up for Flying Blue' card points to that info page; the header 'Log in' button opened a transparent cdk overlay backdrop that then intercepted clicks on the page.
Cookie wall 'KLM uses cookies' on both klm.co.uk and the identity host: click button:has-text("Reject").

One question per screen: the first screen is 'Hi there! What is your name?' (first and last name exactly as on passport/ID; input[formcontrolname="firstName"] / input[formcontrolname="lastName"]) with a Continue button that stays disabled until both are filled. Inputs have no name/id/autocomplete attributes. Later screens (email, password, DOB etc.) were not observed.
identity.airfranceklm.com/enrol/flyingblue opened directly answers 400 Invalid Request; enter via the klm.co.uk 'Join Flying Blue' card.
Screen 2: residence combobox, DOB month combobox (option 'January'), role=textbox[name="day"] / [name="year"], Title combobox (Mr/Ms/Mx/I'd rather not say).
Screen 3 email -> screen 4 emailed one-time PIN (input[autocomplete=one-time-code]) BEFORE the password; the login must be created for airfranceklm.com, the identity host.
